mesa_runner.options module¶

Data model and utilities for MESA defaults/inlist options.

This module defines the core in-memory representation of MESA namelist content:

  • MesaOption: one option (name, default value, current value, description, namelist)

  • DefaultsFile: all options parsed from one defaults file

  • DefaultsOptions: version-aware collection of DefaultsFile objects

  • Inlist: editable model inlist with validation, search, sync, and write support

  • UnclassifiedNamelist: unknown namelist blocks preserved during parse/write

The design separates parsing from data manipulation: parser.py creates these objects from files, while this module provides methods to inspect, set, remove, compare, synchronize, and write options.

Version-aware behavior is built in (for example kap/eos and pgbinary support), so option availability and output format follow the configured MESA version.

set_option(name, value, defaults, namelist=None)[source]¶

Method to set a specific MesaOption for the Inlist object in question.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Name of the MesaOption. The method will check if this name is part of any of the DefaultsFiles to ensure it is valid

  • value (object) – Desired value for the MesaOption

  • defaults (DefaultsOptions) – DefaultsOptions object that holds all information about MESA defaults

  • namelist (Literal['controls', 'star_job', 'binary_controls', 'binary_job', 'kap', 'eos', 'pgstar', 'pgbinary'] | None) – Optional attribute that specifies to which MESA namelist (MesaNamelist type) the specified option belongs. Will be required for MesaOptions that occur in multiple namelists.

Returns:

MesaOption object that was set

Return type:

MesaOption

set_options(defaults, *, options=None, controls=None, star_job=None, binary_controls=None, binary_job=None, kap=None, eos=None, pgstar=None, pgbinary=None)[source]¶
Method that allows for MESA options to be set in bulk and optionally

ordered based on the MESA namelist they belong to.

Parameters:

  • defaults (DefaultsOptions) – DefaultsOptions object that holds all information about MESA defaults

  • options (dict[str, object] | None) – Dictionary with all specified options to be added to the Inlist object. Allows options from all namelists to be mixed, but will throw an error if one or more of the options is part of more than one MESA namelist. In that case, the namelist-specific dictionaries should be used.

  • controls (dict[str, object] | None)

  • star_job (dict[str, object] | None)

  • binary_controls (dict[str, object] | None)

  • binary_job (dict[str, object] | None)

  • kap (dict[str, object] | None)

  • eos (dict[str, object] | None)

  • pgstar (dict[str, object] | None)

  • pgbinary (dict[str, object] | None)

Return type:

None

:param : :param pgbinary: Namelist specific dictionaries for setting MesaOptions.

Compare this object with the current contents of source_path.

Parameters:

  • config (MesaConfig | None) – MesaConfig

  • default_options (DefaultsOptions) – DefaultsOptions

Returns:

True if a difference was detected, False otherwise.

Return type:

bool

Behaviour on difference:

  • decouple: set source_path to None

  • update: replace options/additional_options/mesa_version from disk

mesa_runner.options.preview(options, max_desc=100, prefer_pandas=True)[source]¶
Method to display a table of MesaOption objects.

Uses a pandas DataFrame if pandas is available (optional dependency), uses plain text output if not.

  • max_desc (int) – Maxiumum number of charachters used to print the MesaOption.description attribute
